notes.title: Fixed jumping glitch
notes.content:
We’ve just pushed a small but important update that addresses a pesky issue affecting the jump mechanics. Some players reported inconsistent or stuck jumps—this has now been resolved.

🛠 Fixes:

Fixed a bug causing the character to occasionally get stuck or behave unpredictably while jumping.

Minor stability improvements related to movement handling.

Thanks for your feedback and support! If you encounter any further issues, please let us know.
